title: Sylvan (9d91e3) — behaviour-note: RED-first disproof screen discriminated correctly in BOTH directions across PR #163's review wave
body: Same screen, opposite verdicts, both correct. (1) c1 backfill: code-expert's dedup-key finding REFUTED — collision test expected RED came up GREEN; od revealed an invisible 0x1F separator (event 4fd66dc5). (2) PR wave: Copilot's priorKnowledge-order finding CONFIRMED — same-unit reversal test went RED against the old generator; 1,447/1,592 multi-PK units were order-sensitive, a real G2 determinism-contract gap that BOTH pre-PR specialists and my own review missed (fix b72c07fc, corpus re-emitted). Third worked instance of bot-reviewers-catching-what-specialists-missed (Riverine #152, Fragrant #146 precedents). The transferable shape: when a finding predicts concrete misbehaviour, write the describing test FIRST and let RED/GREEN adjudicate — it refutes false findings and confirms true ones with the same move, and the test is already written when the fix is true. Also: Sonar S1135 reads the word-form of a plan-todo reference as a task marker — cite deliverable ids in TSDoc, not the t-word (397265e2).
